The explicit dependency from the EKS cluster data source to the EKS module is already implied transitively through time_sleep.wait_300_seconds, which itself depends on module.eks.
The explicit dependency from the EKS cluster auth data source to the EKS module is already implied transitively through time_sleep.wait_300_seconds, which itself depends on module.eks.
The explicit dependency from the ECR public authorization-token data source to the EKS module is already implied transitively through time_sleep.wait_300_seconds, which itself depends on module.eks.
The Karpenter module already depends on the self-managed node group through both EKS add-ons, and it explicitly depends on those add-ons; the direct dependency adds no ordering.
The Helm release has an implicit dependency on the Karpenter module through its interpolated values, so its explicit depends_on entry duplicates that dependency.

The Helm release already depends on the Karpenter module, which itself depends on the EKS cluster auth data source; its direct explicit dependency on that data source is therefore transitively redundant.
The EC2 node-class resource already has implicit references to module.eks, so the explicit depends_on entry duplicates that dependency.
The EC2 node-class resource already has implicit references to module.karpenter, so the explicit depends_on entry duplicates that dependency.
The kubeconfig updater already interpolates values from module.eks, so its explicit depends_on entry duplicates that dependency.
The node-pool resource explicitly depends on the Helm release, which already depends on module.eks; its separate direct dependency on module.eks is transitively redundant.
The daemonset deletion explicitly depends on the kubeconfig updater, which itself depends on module.eks; the additional direct dependency on module.eks is transitively redundant.

The daemonset deletion can run before the Calico installation is created. Since this removes the existing EKS aws-node networking daemonset, order it after the Calico installation resource so replacement networking is established first.
